scope: Bounded SA04 inventory, not complete research or rendered proof

value.title: A coalition
value.text: Dalinar tries to unite the monarchs of Roshar against the Voidbringers, with his own past catching up with him.

value.title: The fall of Kholinar
value.text: Kaladin, Shallan, Adolin and Elhokar slip into the occupied capital. The city falls and the king dies.

value.title: Across Shadesmar
value.text: Pulled through the Oathgate into the Cognitive Realm, the survivors walk and sail toward Thaylen City.

value.title: The Battle of Thaylen Field
value.text: Odium sends his champion. Dalinar refuses to give in, binds the realms together and becomes the Bondsmith.

value.title: The truth about humans
value.text: The Alethi learn that their ancestors came from Ashyn as refugees and took the singers’ world.

value.title: Dawnshard
value.text: Rysn’s ship sails for forbidden Akinah and finds something far older than the Radiants.

value.name: Urithiru
value.desc: The ten-tiered tower city of the ancient Radiants, carved from a mountain high in the Mountains of Ur, home of the Sibling and hub of the ten Oathgates.

value.name: Kholinar
value.desc: Alethkar’s capital, built among storm-carved rock fins. Gavilar was murdered in his palace here, and the city falls to the singers in Oathbringer. Its Oathgate was corrupted by the Unmade Sja-anat.

value.name: Celebrant
value.desc: A big spren trading port on the west side of the ‘island’ that mirrors the Sea of Spears. The travellers from Kholinar buy passage here.

value.name: Thaylen City
value.desc: The terraced capital of Thaylenah on the main island’s north-west coast, with the Thalath Oathgate. The Battle of Thaylen Field ends Oathbringer.

value.name: Riino’s lighthouse
value.desc: A stone tower with a heatless bonfire on a peninsula of obsidian that is a river in the Physical Realm. Its exact counterpart is our guess.

value.name: Rathalas (the Rift)
value.desc: A canyon city at the north tip of the Sea of Spears, burned by Dalinar in his years as the Blackthorn.

value.name: Azimir
value.desc: Azir’s capital, with the Bronze Palace and the Grand Market dome over the Makabakam Oathgate. Lift steals food here; Azir is run by scribes and forms.

value.name: The Central Sea
value.desc: The sea at the heart of Ashyn’s old world, across which the ancient empire held its conference.

value.name: Floating cities
value.desc: Survivors live in cities held up in the air by people whose Surge-sickness lets them control gravity.

value.name: Roshar
value.status: Second planet · Shardworld of Honor, Cultivation and Odium
value.blurb: A world of stone and wind scoured by highstorms that roll in from the east every few days. One supercontinent, also called Roshar, holds nearly all its life. Plants pull into the rock when the storm comes, animals carry shells, and spheres left out in a storm fill with Stormlight. The Alethi princes fight an endless war on the Shattered Plains, while old stories speak of Desolations and of the Knights Radiant.
value.short: The storm world of the Stormlight Archive.
facts: Salas, Nomon, Mishim (a fourth broke up long ago)

value.name: Ashyn
value.status: First planet · the Tranquiline Halls of legend
value.blurb: The innermost planet, the world humans came from before Roshar. A global catastrophe, probably from Surges used without restraint, drove most of its people away as refugees. Those who stayed live in floating cities in the sky and a few habitable pockets. The surface is violently volcanic, and the axial tilt gives it seasons. Rosharan myth calls it the Tranquiline Halls.

A world of stone and wind scoured by highstorms from the east, and now by the Everstorm blowing the other way. The Knights Radiant have returned, the singers have woken, and Odium’s Fused are back from Braize. Dalinar Kholin tries to hold a coalition of nations together through the True Desolation.

value.name: Dalinar Kholin
value.desc: A warlord trying to become a better man.

value.title: The truth about humans
value.text: The Alethi learn that their ancestors came from Ashyn as refugees and took the singers’ world.

value.title: Dawnshard
value.text: Rysn’s ship sails for forbidden Akinah and finds something far older than the Radiants.

value.title: Sadeas found dead
value.text: Highprince Sadeas is found murdered in one of the tower’s dark corridors, and Shallan takes up the search for the killer.

value.title: Kaladin among the singers
value.text: Kaladin follows a band of freed parshmen to Revolar, learns how they see the world, and escapes the Fused on a highstorm.

value.title: The Rift burns
value.text: In Dalinar’s returning memories, the Blackthorn burns the rebel city, not knowing his wife Evi is inside.

value.title: Re-Shephir
value.text: Shallan tracks the killings to an Unmade hiding in the tower and drives it off with her Lightweaving.

value.title: Azir joins
value.text: Lift unlocks Azimir’s Oathgate and Dalinar wins the Azish to his coalition, before talks with the singers collapse.

value.title: The Cult of Moments
value.text: Shallan seeks to infiltrate the Cult of Moments in Kholinar.

value.title: The Wall Guard
value.text: Kaladin fights beside Highmarshal Azure’s guard on the walls until a thunderclast breaks through.

value.title: Vision at the lighthouse
value.text: Kaladin looks into a heatless fire and sees Thaylen City overrun and Dalinar surrounded.

value.title: The Bondsmith mends
value.text: Dalinar finds he can mend what is broken, and Queen Fen joins his coalition.

value.title: Excommunicated
value.text: On a visit to Vedenar, the Vorin church casts Dalinar out.

value.title: The Eila Stele
value.text: A translated stone says humans came to Roshar as the invaders, and the coalition starts to come apart.

value.title: The King’s Drop
value.text: A thunderclast smashes the Gemstone Reserve. Dalinar traps the Unmade Nergaoul in the great gem, and the possessed soldiers come back to themselves.

value.name: Urithiru
value.desc: The ten-tiered tower city of the ancient Radiants, carved from a mountain high in the Mountains of Ur, home of the Sibling and hub of the ten Oathgates.

landmarks.name: The Oathgate platforms
landmarks.desc: Ten platforms on the plaza before the tower, each linked to an Oathgate across Roshar. Shallan’s gate from Narak brings the Alethi armies here at the end of Words of Radiance.

landmarks.name: The Gallery of Maps
landmarks.desc: A chamber near the top with a great map table, where Dalinar plans his coalition’s war.

landmarks.name: The Breakaway
landmarks.desc: The cavernous central market hall on the lower levels, where merchants and refugees fill the once-empty tower.

landmarks.name: The dark corridors
landmarks.desc: Miles of lightless, half-explored passages. Sadeas’s body is found in a corridor, and more killings follow.

landmarks.name: Re-Shephir’s chamber
landmarks.desc: A hidden ground-floor chamber where the Unmade Re-Shephir lurks. Shallan confronts her here with Lightweaving and drives her off.

landmarks.name: The gem archive
landmarks.desc: A room where the ancient Radiants stored their records inside gemstones.

landmarks.name: The crystal pillar
landmarks.desc: A pillar of gemstones deep in the tower, the heart of the Sibling. Raboniel pours Voidlight into it to seize the tower; Navani later bonds the Sibling here and becomes a Bondsmith.

landmarks.name: The Devotary of Mercy
landmarks.desc: A fourth-floor hospital for the wounded in mind, where Kaladin, retired from fighting, works with the patients.

landmarks.name: The cistern chamber
landmarks.desc: A water chamber in the tower where Dalinar opens a perpendicularity and goes with Navani into the Spiritual Realm.

value.name: Kholinar
value.desc: Alethkar’s capital, built among storm-carved rock fins. Gavilar was murdered in his palace here, and the city falls to the singers in Oathbringer. Its Oathgate was corrupted by the Unmade Sja-anat.

landmarks.name: The royal palace
landmarks.desc: The Kholin palace. King Gavilar is murdered here on the night of the treaty feast.

landmarks.name: The windblades
landmarks.desc: Sleek, layered rock formations in Kholinar.

landmarks.name: The city wall
landmarks.desc: About sixty feet high, built into the windblades. Highmarshal Azure’s Wall Guard holds it against Fused raids until a thunderclast breaks through.

landmarks.name: The Monastery Dais (Oathgate)
landmarks.desc: The Oathgate platform, joined to the palace by the Sunwalk and used as the ardents’ monastery. Its spren has been corrupted by Sja-anat, and the Cult of Moments holds endless feasts on it.

landmarks.name: Yokska’s shop
landmarks.desc: A tailor’s house where Elhokar, Adolin, Kaladin and Shallan hide while they work out how to reach the Oathgate.

landmarks.name: Wall Guard barracks
landmarks.desc: Azure’s headquarters, where a hidden Soulcaster in an aluminium-lined room keeps soldiers and refugees fed. Kaladin joins the Guard here.

value.name: Celebrant
value.desc: A big spren trading port on the west side of the ‘island’ that mirrors the Sea of Spears. The travellers from Kholinar buy passage here.

landmarks.name: The bead docks
landmarks.desc: A busy spren trading port on the bead sea. The travellers from Kholinar buy passage here on a ship bound toward Thaylen.

value.name: Thaylen City
value.desc: The terraced capital of Thaylenah on the main island’s north-west coast, with the Thalath Oathgate. The Battle of Thaylen Field ends Oathbringer.

landmarks.name: The Oathgate
landmarks.desc: On the north-east edge beside the Royal Ward, long used as a sculpture garden, until it is cleared and reopened to Urithiru.

landmarks.name: Temple of Talenelat
landmarks.desc: One of ten Herald temples in the Royal Ward. Dalinar finds his Bondsmith power when he mends a broken statue and this damaged temple, and Queen Fen joins his coalition.

landmarks.name: The Eila Stele
landmarks.desc: An ancient carved stone kept in the city. Its translation says humans came to Roshar as the invaders, and the coalition nearly breaks apart over it.

landmarks.name: The Gemstone Reserve
landmarks.desc: The national bank, which holds the great gemstone called the King’s Drop. The thunderclast Yushah smashes it during the battle.

landmarks.name: The city wall
landmarks.desc: Runs north to south below the city. Breached in the battle; the gap is later sealed with Soulcast metal.

landmarks.name: Thaylen Field
landmarks.desc: The docks and market district outside the wall, wrecked by the Everstorm. Odium’s armies and the possessed Sadeas troops fight here, and Dalinar faces Odium.

landmarks.name: The Royal Palace
landmarks.desc: Seat of the Thaylen monarchs and of Queen Fen.

value.name: Riino’s lighthouse
value.desc: A stone tower with a heatless bonfire on a peninsula of obsidian that is a river in the Physical Realm. Its exact counterpart is our guess.

landmarks.name: Riino’s lighthouse
landmarks.desc: A stone tower with a fire that gives no heat. Kaladin looks into it and sees Thaylen City overrun and Dalinar surrounded.

value.name: Rathalas (the Rift)
value.desc: A canyon city at the north tip of the Sea of Spears, burned by Dalinar in his years as the Blackthorn.

landmarks.name: The Rift
landmarks.desc: The canyon city that rebels against Gavilar. In Dalinar’s memories he burns it to the ground, not knowing that his wife Evi is inside.

value.name: Azimir
value.desc: Azir’s capital, with the Bronze Palace and the Grand Market dome over the Makabakam Oathgate. Lift steals food here; Azir is run by scribes and forms.

landmarks.name: The Bronze Palace
landmarks.desc: Seat of the Prime Aqasix. Lift breaks in to steal food, and the boy Gawx, whom she heals, is chosen as Prime.

landmarks.name: The Grand Market
landmarks.desc: An indoor market under a great bronze dome, built over the city’s Oathgate. The Azish fortify it once they learn what is underneath.

landmarks.name: The Makabakam Oathgate
landmarks.desc: The platform under the market dome, which Lift unlocks to open the way to Urithiru.
